source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Load driver via command below $ sudo modprobe amdgpu ras_enable=1 2. Check amdgpu umc error count is zero via command below $ sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1 3. Execute the following command for Decode Correctable Error Record - Inject an uncorrectable error: $sudo amdgpuras -b 2 -t 4 -d 1 4. Execute the following command for Query error status and decode correctable error record: $ sudo amdgpuras -C -d 1 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
